body_text:
Every complex number has a unique Cartesian form $z=x+iy$ with
$x,y\in\mathbb{R}$. For $z\ne0$ it also has polar forms
$z=re^{i\theta}$, where $r=|z|>0$ and the argument $\theta$ is
determined modulo $2\pi$. Thus the modulus is unique but a
single-valued argument requires a branch convention.
